verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no registrable outbound webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. The webhook mention (graphite-docs-24) describes Graphite receiving inbound GitHub webhooks. 'Slack notifications' (graphite-docs-58) is a chat-app integration and does not qualify. missing for 10: documented outbound webhook subscriptions, event catalog, payload/delivery documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
